answers:
1. Honestly, the one I'd point to is the elephant toothpaste demo. I've done it every year since my first, and I closed with it that last day. I can't name a specific lesson I kept going back to, so I'd skip that part.

2. I don't have a particular question I can point to, so I'd rather not make one up. Maybe just cut that line or keep it vague.

3. Amina Yusuf came to mind, because she showed up that day with her young daughter to watch. She's a pharmacist now. Beyond that I'd rather not add details.

4. My last class was period 4 AP Chemistry, and the last thing I did was the elephant toothpaste demo. I don't remember what I picked up last or what I did after, so I'd skip that.

5. Not really a date on a calendar, no. I felt relieved as much as sad, and I'm a little embarrassed by that. I also don't have a real plan for what comes next.

<final>
On my last day at Lakeview High, after 31 years of teaching chemistry, I straightened the lab stools, checked the taps, and wiped down a bench that was already clean. My last class was period 4 AP Chemistry, and I closed with the elephant toothpaste demo, which I've done every year since my first. Amina Yusuf was on my mind that day because she showed up with her young daughter to watch. She's a pharmacist now. I felt relieved as much as sad, and I'm a little embarrassed by that. I don't have a real plan for what comes next. I took my time gathering my things.
</final>
